reviews.text: My company uses Poor Richards Catering all the time. They consistently provide great food with great service. They are on time with delivery and set everything up beautifully. I will continue to use them as long as I have a catering need in Philadelphia. Keep up the good work!
reviews.author: Peter Cosgrove

reviews.text: Suoer friendly staff. I have used these guys for their sandwich platters on multiple occasions. My clients are always happy and satisfied. Strongly recommend their hot food services as well. The owners are very hands on in the communication process. You will not be disappointed!
reviews.author: jesse batt

reviews.text: I would recommend this Caterer for any Event.  Can Create whatever you may need Great kitchen Staff, Great Chefs !!! Succulent Eats
